title: S1-S3-S4 Drift Compensation Testing & Structural Analysis
changes_tested: S1: IS Alpha BTC benchmark cap @ 35%
S3: Regime drift KL divergence detector

run1_s1_s2_s3_s4.notes: S2 vol gate collapsed Chop PF from 1.11→0.48; S4 simplified score selected wrong champion

run2_s1_s3_only.notes: Config hash change created fresh study. S3 drift detector confirms CRISIS 8.07× mismatch. S1 cap irrelevant when IS CAGR < 0%.

critical_findings.structural_bottleneck: 18 OOS CRISIS trades (PF=0.36-0.40) block positive OOS CAGR. Root cause: HMM trained on IS (2% CRISIS) cannot generalize to OOS (15.9% CRISIS, ratio 8.07×). These bars have hmm_prob_crisis < 0.66 → no kill-switch → full leverage loss.
critical_findings.s2_vol_gate_failure: Intended to catch IS-OOS mismatch. But IS CRISIS bars have G=+0.193% (profitable). Vol-gate zero-lev blocks them → IS CAGR 30%→2.6% collapse.
critical_findings.s4_simplified_score_failure: Raw-value formula without bounded normalization preferentially selects near-zero conservative trials over genuine performers. Simplified vs original select different champions with vastly different IS performance.
critical_findings.is_alpha_gate_ineffectiveness: BTC cap at 35% helps only when IS CAGR > 0%. When IS CAGR ≈ 0%, cap is irrelevant — gate fails by same margin (e.g., -35%).
critical_findings.config_hash_sensitivity: New config keys changed study hash → fresh Optuna exploration. Fresh studies show higher selection variance. Previous P0-1+P0-2 run had explored the space and found good local optima.

solution_path.recommended_next: Implement OOS-only CRISIS threshold calibration: run_oos_margin_shared_portfolio() use lower threshold (e.g., 0.50) only for OOS eval, keep 0.66 for AWF IS optimization. This catches the 8.07× additional OOS CRISIS bars while preserving IS training dynamics.
solution_path.complexity: Moderate (2-3 file edits in evaluator + optimizer)
